sections.value: Security round 2 for #327 at c515a66: pass. Delta 062aa0a..c515a66 is one commit (c515a664). It touches only crates/testkit/src/fakes.rs (FakeQueue::ack_delivery) and crates/testkit/src/contract.rs (a shared queue_contract case run on both the fake and SQLite). No production store or daemon code changed, so the round-1 findings stand: the real ack fails only its own row, and only when that row's own payload-derived sender is ''. The outcome is the constant undelivered:no-sender. The fake now does what SQLite does: it looks the claim up without removing it, runs require_delivery_job first, then the sender check, and only then removes it. That makes it stricter, never looser: a misfiled claim is refused and left running, untouched, and named senders take the same path after the same kind check. The fake therefore cannot end a row the real queue would keep. The contract now pins the real queue's order too. No kill, launch or path handling, and no secrets, lockfile or .npmrc changes. Nothing new for notes_owed.
